flavor_text.one_line: Cinwyn — domineering martial aristocracy of the synthesis; conquest, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Cinwyn are a vigorous martial aristocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Albawyn and Qinzhao [Conquest Aristocracy (albawyn over qinzhao)]. They prize conquest, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field light_infantry, chariots, berserkers. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
